_comment: Solaris project manifest. Framework + plugin versions live here; the project's own semver lives in the root .version file. Standalone collaborators: you may edit project.workspaces and plugins[]; the revisions map is Solaris sync metadata - leave it as-is (merge conflicts in it: take either side). No host/deploy/secret specifics - those live in ai/.memory/. plugins[] entries are {name, version} for copied plugins, {name, "mode": "link"} (no version - always live) for linked ones.
